en: A colorized vintage postcard view of a canal lined with historic brick buildings and towers. The scene shows the picturesque waterfront with reflections in the water, trees on the left, stepped-gable and turreted houses on the right, and a tall tower in the background. At the top is printed text identifying the location, and there is a small printer's mark in the upper-right corner.
